# Teaching with inspectable synthetic methods

The four interactive AquaTrajectories teaching labs can be used without uploading video, installing R or supplying live-animal data. They illustrate research workflow concepts with **invented coordinates, boxes, labels and recording designs**. Their calculations are deterministic for a declared seed, but **are not independent validation studies**.

## 1. Fish detection and tracker identity

The [synthetic detection and tracking laboratory](../scientific-tracking-lab.html) shows labelled true boxes, predicted boxes and frame-by-frame matching. Users manipulate missed-detection frequency, false positives, location noise, overlap threshold and assigned ID changes. The browser computes precision, recall and F1 from its invented boxes. Its adjacent-frame tracker-ID change count is deliberately **not** reported as HOTA, IDF1 or another official multi-object tracking metric.

See the actual package's [detection and tracking functions](../reference/index.html#detection-tracking-and-annotation-validation) and the [independent benchmark protocol](validation-and-benchmarks.html).

## 2. Movement mathematics

The [mathematics workbench](../math-workbench.html) visualizes finite-difference speed, directional group polarization and an affine camera-clock mapping. Each panel provides controlled inputs, an algebraic expression, numerical results and direct links to released function manuals.

The browser formulas demonstrate the concept. In real data, missing observations, unit conversions, timestamps, valid nonzero velocities, and independently verified physical clock markers constrain interpretation.

## 3. Adjustable plot families

The [plot parameter playground](../plot-playground.html) supports three representative function families: `aqt_plot_paths()`, `aqt_plot_ensemble2d()` and `aqt_plot_school_dynamics()`. The live browser SVG is a **schematic simulation**, not a screenshot produced by R. The exported R snippet calls the *actual* released v0.1.1 function using the displayed class of parameters. The [22-function plot atlas](all-plot-functions.html) retains 16 native base-R outputs and six labelled 2D projections of optional `rgl` inputs.

## 4. Downloadable planning protocols

The [experiment protocol builder](../experiment-protocol-builder.html) creates a synthetic study-design checklist and CSV manifest for planned tank × session × camera records. Sensitive or real acquisition fields (video paths, SHA-256 hashes, independent timing and measured underwater reference targets) remain empty until a researcher enters genuine evidence.

The planner does not randomize treatments, obtain approval, create surveyed XYZ targets, or turn synthetic observations into biological results. See [experiment design](experimental-design.html) and the [camera-specific recording planner](plan-your-experiment.html).

## Citable software and empirical limits

These lessons refer to [AquaTrajectories v0.1.1](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/releases/tag/v0.1.1), [DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24262905](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24262905). Laboratory teaching metrics, formula readouts, and scenario images cannot establish fish-detection accuracy on original video, independently reviewed identity, refractive metrology, or causal welfare effects. Check the [evidence and validation dashboard](research-evidence-dashboard.html) before making scientific claims.
